column1: # frozen.tsv (harbor#1276) - the names a stranger types or reads. Written by bin/frozen-gen.sh --apply, never by hand.
# WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. A name a stranger types is an interface: renaming it breaks their scripts and habits.
# A row is added when its name first appears and never dropped; renaming one needs a renames.tsv row with its alias.
# Columns: id (<kind>:<name>), kind, name, since (the date it was first frozen).
